# netskopebwan_vpnpeer (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskopebwan_vpnpeer" "example" {
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
  ikev2 = {
    dh_group          = 1
    dpd_timeout       = 1
    encryption        = "any"
    hash              = "any"
    ike_sa_lifetime   = 1
    ipsec_sa_lifetime = 1
  }
  ip_address = "<ip_address>"
  location = {
    lat = 1
    lng = 1
  }
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Description of the VPN Peer.
- `ikev2` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ikev2))
- `ip_address` (String) Ip Address of the VPN Peer.
- `location` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `name` (String) Display name of the VPN Peer.

### Optional

- `ip_location` (Boolean) Indicates whether Ip Location is enabled
- `type` (String) type of the vpn peer Must be one of: `IKEV2`, `GRE`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `created_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--created_by))
- `disabled_at` (String) Time object record was disabled in ISO 8601 format.
For example '2019-05-08T05:30:30.206Z'
- `id` (String) VPN Peer ID
- `modified_at` (String)
- `modified_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modified_by))

<a id="nestedatt--ikev2"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ikev2`

Required:

- `dh_group` (Number) Dh Group of the VPN Peer.
- `dpd_timeout` (Number) Dpd Timeout in seconds
- `encryption` (String) type of encryption to be used Must be one of: `any`, `AES_CBC_128`, `AES_CBC_192`, `AES_CBC_256`, `AES_GCM_128`, `AES_GCM_192`, `AES_GCM_256`.
- `hash` (String) type of hash to be used Must be one of: `any`, `SHA2_256`, `SHA2_384`, `SHA2_512`.
- `ike_sa_lifetime` (Number) Ike SA Lifetime in seconds
- `ipsec_sa_lifetime` (Number) Ipsec SA Lifetime in seconds

Optional:

- `pfs` (Boolean) Indicates whether Pfs is enabled

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netskopebwan_vpnpeer.example <id>
```
